notes.title: Viviette v1.1 - Adjustments and fixes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33444235/a65e51f0e7932b1b6bd07a7e8411c6526a415380.png[/img]

Viviette [b]v1.1[/b] is now live, featuring the following changes:

- The logic behind the sea creatures puzzle has been changed.
- Fixed a possible bug with the crows puzzle.
- Added / tweaked some events.
- Minor player and enemy behavior adjustments.
- Improved visuals.

Thank you very much to all players supporting this game and leaving positive feedback, we really appreciate that.

Have a nice day!

[i]Alberto & Dani[/i]

notes.title: v1.0.4 - Musical puzzle adjustments
notes.content:
Hello!

In order to make the [b]musical puzzle[/b] more accesible, we have made some tweaks in [b]v1.0.4[/b]:

- The melody sounds a bit slower.
- The musical instrument sounds clearer.
- The number of notes to memorize depends on the difficulty mode.
- The pattern complexity depends on game difficulty (this only applies to new games).

We hope that helps!

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: v1.0.3 - More bug fixes and tweaks
notes.content:
Hello!

We have just uploaded [b]v1.0.3[/b], which simply fixes some bugs and adds minor adjustments regarding puzzle clues and difficulty.

[b]1.0.3[/b] - [i]23/10/2018[/i]
- Added more colored text clues in some puzzles.
- Fixed movement bugs in crows.
- Melody puzzle complexity now depends on game difficulty.

As always, if you find serious bugs, just post them in our [url=steamcommunity.com/app/883070/discussions/1/]support forum[/url] and we'll fix them as soon as possible.

Thanks!

notes.title: v1.0.2 - Bug fixes
notes.content:
Hello again!

This is another hot-fix that should solve several issues with the [b]enemy AI[/b], among other things.

[b]1.0.2[/b] - [i]21/10/2018[/i]
- Improved enemy AI.
- Fixed movement bugs in enemy AI.
- Fixed bug when opening doors at the same time.
- Fixed possible bug on left bathroom.

This update should make the game quite stable, with no game breaking issues. So, all next updates, if any, won't come that fast. Anyway, if you find serious bugs again, let us know in the forums and we will fix them as soon as possible.

Thanks!

[i]Alberto & Dani[/i]

notes.title: Viviette Release Date: 18 October 2018
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Our upcoming new game, [b]Viviette[/b], now has an official release date:

[h1]18 October 2018[/h1]

Well, that's next week, on Thursday!

Viviette is an [b]exploration-puzzle[/b] game with touches of [b]classic horror[/b]. We highly recommend avoiding any kind of spoliers before playing the game, so that you can enjoy the full experience your own way. We think the game is super immersive from start to end.

In adversity, you should persevere. But if you get stuck in the game, just ask for help in the project's [url=steamcommunity.com/app/883070/discussions/]discussions forum[/url]. We won't reply, but surely other players will do. We will only reply to bug reports or technical issues, though we think the game is bug free.

Meanwhile, adding it to your [b]wishlist[/b] will help with visibility before launch:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/883070/Viviette/

Thanks for reading!

[i]Alberto & Dani[/i]
